indicators.source: FRED series NGDPSAXDCARQ · IMF International Financial Statistics, trailing 4-quarter sum, seasonally adjusted, with the latest quarters from the OECD quarterly national accounts (falls back to World Bank current US$, annual, only if the live ARS series is unavailable on a given run). Note: this nominal series is seasonally adjusted while the real GDP series on this page is not, so the two are not on a like-for-like basis; compare their growth rates rather than reading a deflator off the gap between them.

FRED series NGDPRNSAXDCARQ · IMF International Financial Statistics, quarterly, not seasonally adjusted, with the latest quarters from the OECD quarterly national accounts. Large regular swings between quarters partly reflect seasonal patterns, not just the underlying trend.

Derived from FRED series NGDPRNSAXDCARQ · IMF International Financial Statistics, real GDP, not seasonally adjusted, year on year (each quarter against the same quarter a year earlier, because quarter-on-quarter changes in unadjusted data mostly reflect the seasons). The latest quarters come from the OECD quarterly national accounts.

Calculated from real GDP, each period against the same period a year earlier. Real GDP: FRED series NGDPRNSAXDCARQ · IMF International Financial Statistics, quarterly, not seasonally adjusted, with the latest quarters from the OECD quarterly national accounts. Large regular swings between quarters partly reflect seasonal patterns, not just the underlying trend.
INDEC · consumer price index (IPC), national, all items (Nivel general), year on year.
INDEC · consumer price index (IPC), national, all items (Nivel general), month on month, derived from the same index used for the year-on-year figure.
World Bank SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS · modeled ILO estimate, % of total labour force, annual.
